fields.label: Apportionment method
fields.value: Multistate unitary corporations apportion Maryland modified income using a single sales factor formula (100% sales factor). A qualifying worldwide headquartered company may elect annually to apportion income using a three-factor double-weighted sales formula.
fields.quote: 342 – 3 – attributable to trade or business carried on in the State shall be determined using a single sales factor apportionment formula, by multiplying its Maryland modified income by 100% of the sales factor.

fields.label: Special industry rules
fields.value: Special apportionment formulas apply to financial institutions, transportation companies, airlines, motion picture and television producers, and rental or leasing companies.
fields.source_citation: Tax Year 2025 PTE Booklet 510 Pass-Through Entity Income Tax Return
fields.quote: Rental/ leasing companies, financial institutions, transportation companies, and worldwide headquartered companies must use a Special Apportionment Formula (see instruction 4 below), unless the Comptroller has accepted an Alternative Apportionment Formula (see instruction 5 below).

fields.label: Forms
fields.value: Corporations compute apportionment on Schedule A of Form 500. Pass-through entities compute apportionment on Schedule B of Form 510 or Form 511.
fields.source_citation: Tax Year 2025 PTE Booklet 510 Pass-Through Entity Income Tax Return
fields.quote: In addition to filing Form 500 to calculate and pay the corporation income tax, also file Form 510.

fields.label: Sales and use tax
fields.value: The Maryland state sales and use tax rate is 6.0%. Local jurisdictions do not levy local sales taxes.
fields.source_citation: Sales and Use Tax List of Tangible Personal Property and Services
fields.quote: ~ 43 ~ subject to the sales and use tax rate of 6%, applied to 94.5% of the gross receipts from the machine.

fields.label: Key forms
fields.value: Main business forms include Form 500 for corporations, Form 510 for standard pass-through entities, and Form 511 for electing pass-through entities. Additional key forms include composite return Form 510C, estimated tax forms Form 500D and Form 510/511D, and extension forms Form 500E and Form 510/511E.
fields.quote: See Form 502CR Instructions and attach Maryland Schedule K-1 (Form 510/511) issued to you.
